candidateAudit.text: Best Christmas gift for rollercoaster lovers! This Vienna restaurant delivers your food by ROLLERCOASTER 🎢🍔 Welcome to ROLLERCOASTERRESTAURANT Vienna, the rollercoaster restaurant in the Prater amusement park, right at the Giant Ferris Wheel. If you’re searching for unique restaurants in Vienna, fun things to do in Vienna, or where to eat in Vienna with kids, save this one. How it works: 📱 You order everything on a tablet 🤖 Robots load your food and drinks onto tiny sleds 🎢 Your meal is catapulted through loops and glides down the rails straight to your table 🍹 Robot arms shake the cocktails, which arrive in sealed jars Between courses you get light shows and dancing robots, so it’s dinner and a show in one. On the menu: burgers, fries, noodles, nuggets, salads and vegan options, plus the restaurant’s own One More drinks. 📍 Riesenradplatz 6/1, 1020 Vienna (Wiener Prater) 🕐 Mon–Thu 12:00–22:30, Fri–Sun 11:30–22:30 🎟 Book your table online at rollercoaster.rest 🎂 Birthday shows with cake and a light show One of the most fun restaurants in Vienna, Austria, and a must for your Vienna travel bucket list. candidateAudit.text: 🇷🇴 Aluat subțire, o lingură de dulceață, o ploaie de zahăr pudră… ce să fie oare? Sunt Clătitele noastre, adică Palatschinken pe limba vienezilor: foi fine, rumenite la tigaie și rulate cu dulceață de căpșuni sau de afine, iar pentru cei cu poftă de ciocolată, cu cremă de ciocolată. Un desert românesc la Viena care se termină mereu mai repede decât crezi. Duminica asta, lasă-ți ultimul loc de pe masă pentru o porție de clătite. 🇦🇹 Zart, goldgelb, süß und aufgerollt – na, was könnte das wohl sein? Natürlich Palatschinken, bei uns Clătite genannt: hauchdünn in der Pfanne gebacken und wahlweise mit Erdbeermarmelade, mit Heidelbeermarmelade oder mit Schokocreme gefüllt. Eine rumänische Nachspeise in Wien, die am Teller selten lange Zeit zum Abkühlen hat. Heb dir für diesen Sonntag ein Eckerl Platz auf und bestell sie zum Schluss. 🇬🇧 Thin, golden, rolled up and ready for jam or chocolate: our clătite are Romanian crêpes that make a very good case for dessert first.
